title: JA Boxing follow-ups: generic categories keep their name, seeder sends temperature, chat prices stay text
steps: S1: node --test apps/tracy-web/test/joomla-categories-section-labels.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/joomla-blog-categories.test.mjs (a leaf category titled Classes is not asked nor renamed; demo topics still are).
S2: node --test packages/cms/tracy-seeder/test/model-temperature.test.mjs (temperature 0 and 0.4 reach the request body; unset sends none).
S3 (fork, inside vendor/tracy/deepseek-harness after its own install): ./node_modules/.bin/vitest run packages/client/ui-primitives/tests/markdown-dollar-amounts.client.spec.tsx.
S4 (dev, after deploy): ask Tracy in a site chat for an answer with "$49 per month and $99 per year".
expect: S4: the prices read as plain text; no KaTeX element in the reply.
evidence: saigon-iron-boxing.tracy.site (25/10/2026): main menu and category Classes renamed Boxing Basics; Tracy chat drew $ amounts as a formula; seeder chat() body had no temperature.
fence: Pure functions and a parser extension; the dev check S4 is by hand or Playwright.
